row.title: UNSTICK-CLEAN-1: unstick starts every PR from a clean tree
row.body: In ciwatch run 44968652106 an aborted reconcile left README.md modified, so the next PR's merge stopped with 'Entry README.md not uptodate'. unstick_prs.sh now aborts, hard-resets and cleans before each PR; test_unstick_clean proves the tree ends clean.

title: UNSTICK-CLEAN-1: unstick starts every PR from a clean tree
